description: Assess the supplied CV only (assessmentKind=source_only), without generating a document or predicted after score. With v2b, method=offer-phrase-coverage-v1 measures exact positive coverage of frozen phrases copied from offer requirements and duties, with phrase counts and matched/missing lists; an empty inventory scores zero. Other engines retain method=jev-probability-v1 with semantic per-requirement probabilities. Neither is an employer ATS score or hiring probability. Use tailor_cv for actual before/after documents.

cvText.description: The full CV/resume as plain text.

name: score_cv
